job.goal: 30-second promo plus a short product walkthrough

scenes.brief: Display the Orinovate logo with tagline on a branded background.
Show a dynamic aerial view of a modern workspace transitioning into the Orinovate software interface.
Present a hero still of a diverse team collaborating around a screen displaying Orinovate's dashboard.
Demonstrate creating a new project in the Orinovate dashboard by dragging and dropping tools.
End with a call to action: Visit orinovate.com to learn more.

voiceover.script: Welcome to Orinovate, the platform that empowers teams to innovate faster. Experience seamless workflow automation that turns ideas into action. Watch as our intuitive interface lets you create, manage, and deploy projects with just a few clicks. See how easy it is to start a new project, drag in your tools, and launch results instantly. Visit orinovate.com today to transform your work.
